trial.a: When you sign up you activate the chosen plan with no immediate charge. You get a verification email and full access during the trial. After it ends, set up PayPal to continue.

paypal.q: How do I pay after the trial?
paypal.a: Subscription is managed securely via PayPal. You can cancel anytime from your billing panel.

email.q: Do I need to verify my email?
email.a: Yes. For security we send a verification link when you register. Without verification, panel access stays limited.

plans.a: Yes. From billing you can upgrade or downgrade as your church needs change.

cancel.a: Yes, with no penalty. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

reino.q: What does Kingdom plan include today?
reino.a: Higher limits, audit logs, dedicated support, Apostle multi-site, Camps & Retreats, and Children's Church included. External API remains on the roadmap. Each daughter church can have its own plan.

apostol.a: It is the multi-site network included in Kingdom Plan: manage daughter churches with a network panel and church switcher. Each daughter pays its own plan (or trial). There is no separate Apostle fee.

camps.q: What does the Camps module include?
camps.a: Retreat logistics: map/floor plan, campers, sign-ups and payments, roll call, buses, live itinerary, alerts, health, and staff chat. Included in Kingdom Plan; on Seed/Growth it is a $20/mo PayPal add-on.

kids.a: Safe kids check-in and pickup: allergies and consents, family QR codes, family check-in, PIN and pickup photo, room map, MISSING alarm, and reports. Included in Kingdom Plan; no PayPal add-on for other plans in MVP.
